rationale: Record gains adressesperreTilganger component; DTO appears to model an upstream Altinn response, but no file shows it exposed or consumed by an HTTP operation.
Adds new model classes (Package, PackageDescription, PackagesBody) with no changes to existing handlers shown; no operation behaviour changes.
Only struct tag additions (readOnly, doc) for documentation generation; json/validation tags unchanged.
createProject now trims the name and rejects names shorter than minimum after trimming (INCORRECT_REQUEST); patch name replace also trims. Previously whitespace-padded short names were accepted.
SetTrustedLocation merged into SetLocation with a JsonIgnore trusted flag; client-sent locations remain ignored, trusted ones applied. Refactor.

PageRequestImpl no longer asserts on invalid page: number below 1 (including 0 and negatives) becomes 1; previously 0 was accepted as index 0 and negatives threw. Page output for such requests differs.
Only adds a timeout cause message to the context; same timeout and result.
Diagnostics service held in a field and passed to a constructor; no behavioural change.

Kafka operations now run on a bounded executor; when pool and queue are full, consumer operations return 503 'Bridge is overloaded'. Previously no such rejection; requests were processed. Contract lists no 503.
Changes charge due-date used in a business event payload (effective due date); event serializer is not an HTTP response.
Preview generation refactored into helpers; cache errors now logged and fall back to rendering. Same preview bytes returned.
Adds primarySpec yaml field to a version data struct used for file/config representation; no HTTP operation shown reaching it.
Batch check now sets the per-result error text to the limitation when membership is unknown and strict mode is on; previously empty. Allowed value unchanged.
Settings key enum value server.footer.links renamed to server.sidebar.links; requests using the old key are no longer matched, new key now required.
